guidance: France requires works council notification for supplier contracts above €50,000 and mandates French-language contract addendums.
Germany requires data processing agreements (DPA) for any supplier handling personal data, per GDPR and BDSG.
US engagements over $100,000 require a signed Master Service Agreement (MSA) and SOC 2 review for IT suppliers.
UK engagements must confirm IR35 status for any contractor-based services before proceeding.
Spain requires local tax registration verification for suppliers invoicing above €30,000.
Italy requires anti-mafia certification (Documento Antimafia) for contracts above €150,000.
Belgium requires works council consultation for supplier changes affecting more than 20 employees.
Netherlands requires a Works Council (Ondernemingsraad) advisory review for strategic supplier changes.
No country-specific guidance is available. Default to global policy and recommend confirming local requirements with regional procurement contact.
